Title: Dev auto FIELD_ENCRYPTION_KEY
Description: When FIELD_ENCRYPTION_KEY is missing in dev, auto-generate a Fernet key, persist it to ./data/field_encryption_key (or FIELD_ENCRYPTION_KEY_FILE), and validate keys early so admin token/proxy flows don't 500.
Acceptance: Admin token create + proxy import no longer fail with 'Encryption not configured' in dev; key persists across restarts; invalid key fails fast.
Notes: evidence: pytest(230 passed); covers key generation/persistence test

Title: Docs/env example for encryption
Description: Document FIELD_ENCRYPTION_KEY auto-generation in dev + add FIELD_ENCRYPTION_KEY_FILE option for secret mounts; update deploy env example to reduce misconfiguration.
Acceptance: Docs mention: prod must set FIELD_ENCRYPTION_KEY; dev auto-generates and persists; FILE option described; .env.example updated.

Title: Ignore backend data artifacts
Description: Prevent accidental check-in of backend-local data dirs/caches when running from backend/ working dir (sqlite db, key file, pytest cache).
